.github/workflows/ci.yml#zizmor.justification: The reviewed zizmor reusable workflow invokes a container action, while local workers deliberately receive no Docker socket.

.github/workflows/ci.yml#runner-policy.justification: The policy enforcement path must remain independent of the fleet and able to report invalid local routing.

.github/workflows/ci.yml#ci-status.justification: The required-check aggregator stays hosted and gates actual workload outcomes; selector infrastructure may fail independently while workloads use their literal hosted fallback.

.github/workflows/claude-review.yml#revi.justification: Claude review mints an OIDC credential and writes pull-request comments, so it remains isolated on GitHub-hosted compute.

.github/workflows/link-check.yml#link-ch.justification: The scheduled link checker can create or update repository issues and therefore remains on GitHub-hosted compute.
